v3.sentence: Split-payment world (locked in advance; high phone-signal noise, K=10, 3 seeds): the mule-score model's order got 97.1% of the best possible, against 96.7% for biggest amount first and 42.2% for biggest case first. That is +0.3 points against the better simple rule; the pass mark was +2, so the model's order has not earned its place in this world. Even perfect knowledge of who is a mule would only reach 97.1% (+0.4 points), so no model could have passed this bar: in this world the amount already gives away who the mules are.
